name: Virtual Analog Dual
author: Emilie Gillet
description: One of Emilie Gillet's alternate virtual-analog designs preserved in the Plaits source: independent waveforms, interval detuning, and a synchronized alternate output.

controls.label: Detune and sync
controls.description: Detunes the secondary oscillator through musical intervals and sets the mono hard-sync AUX ratio.

controls.label: Primary waveform
controls.description: Changes the primary oscillator continuously from saw through square and pulse shapes.

controls.label: Secondary waveform
controls.description: Changes the secondary oscillator independently through the same variable waveform range.

controls.label: Detune range
controls.description: Scales interval detuning from unison to twice the original range; the midpoint is Emilie's original spread.

outputs.main: Mono: equal primary/detuned-secondary mix. Stereo: left-weighted primary/detuned-secondary mix.
outputs.aux: Mono: equal primary/hard-sync-secondary mix. Stereo: right-weighted primary/detuned-secondary mix.

trigger: The oscillator phases free-run; patched TRIG restarts Plaits' shared decay and low-pass-gate envelope.
upstream: Mutable Instruments eurorack Plaits source, original VA_VARIANT 0 with Plaits Palette macro and stereo integration
